_comment: REGRESSION SCENARIO for channels 1+3 - rerun this after any driver/scenario-runner change touching bidirectional DShot. PASSED 2026-08-31 (captures/2026-08-31_20-56-27). Concurrency/stability stress test for the only 2 motor-mounted channels on this ESC instance (channels 1 and 3), using the natural production layout - channel 1 on PIO0 (sm0/rx1), channel 3 on PIO1 (sm4/rx5), separate blocks (not the artificially-shared-PIO0 config from two_channel_bidir_smoke.json's decisive cross-talk test). Both start at throttle 60, hold 5s, ramp together to 200 over 5s, then diverge for the remaining 50s: motor 1 accelerates 200->300, motor 3 decelerates 200->100. Result: 100% CRC-valid on both (motor 0: 30221/30221, motor 2: 30220/30221 - one isolated frame, not a streak), 0 dropped, largest gap 10.6ms, ~504/s sustained. 5s-windowed eRPM trend confirms the divergence is clean and matches commanded direction with no crossover/aliasing between channels: both track together through the shared ramp (~8.3k->~27.2k eRPM), then split monotonically from t=10s (motor 0 climbs 49k->74k, motor 2 falls 48k->24k). Channels 2 and 4 held idle (TX-only, no motor mounted) - channel 4 is separately known-bad and parked, not exercised here. min_record_rate_hz=450 confirmed with real margin (measured ~504/s).
